$comment: Example Observatory catalogue. Copy it to projects.config.json (which git ignores) and point each path at a project on your disk. Relative paths are resolved from the folder you run npm run scan / npm run capture in. This example assumes Nova Agent repos are cloned side by side. Hand-written facts (goal, vision, features, how to show it) live here; scan.mjs adds the measured facts and capture.mjs adds screenshots and video. capture.mode: page | images | none. private: true keeps a project out of capture unless you pass --include-private.

projects.name: Calendar
projects.tagline: A cosmic calendar of note cards and day cards
projects.goal: Plan days under a real sky: note cards with an author, start and finish time and their own generated space picture, collected into themed day cards for birthdays, seasonal days and studio sessions.
projects.vision: A calendar that feels like part of the Novacane universe: every day sits under the real moon, and every note gets its own small piece of the cosmos.
features: Note cards with author, start and finish times, and a seeded generative space image
Day cards with presets (birthday, Halloween, Christmas, solstices, meteor showers…)
Seven title aesthetics: Nebula, Supernova, Orbit, Constellation, Eclipse, Aurora, Celestial
Six colour themes: Novacane, Solar Flare, Pulsar, Aurora, Eclipse, Quasar
Moon phases and seasons worked out to the minute (Meeus)
Works offline from a single folder; JSON backup and restore

projects.name: Observatory
projects.goal: A dashboard of every project being worked on: where it lives in the folder tree, what it is for, how big it is, and what it looks like in screenshots and video.
projects.vision: One place to look up and see the whole body of work at once, kept true by scanning the disk rather than by hand.
features: scan.mjs measures size, files, lines of code, languages, git history and last activity
capture.mjs records screenshots and demo videos in headless Chromium
Slideshow videos built with ffmpeg for projects that only have still pictures
Star map of the folder structure
Search, filter and sort; a detailed view for each project
projects.run: npm run build, then open index.html

projects.name: Nova Agent
projects.tagline: The studio's one app: chat, Quests and every panel
projects.goal: The studio's one app (Nova Desk and Nova Phone): Agent, Quests, Calendar, Notes and every panel. It reads the studio's bookings from Nova Bot and plans quests around them.
projects.vision: A tireless studio assistant that plans everyone's days around the studio's bookings and reports back to staff phones.
features: Agent: chat with tools for quests, Calendar, the studio's bookings (read-only), clients and drafts
Quests planned hour by hour around the studio's bookings
Checks in with the Nova Bot worker within about a second (quest taps, booking changes)
Live visualizer: every step Nova Agent takes
projects.run: Runs as the agent-nova systemd user service; visualizer on http://127.0.0.1:4545

projects.name: Nova Bot
projects.tagline: The studio's AI chat assistant, plus Portal for staff
projects.goal: The AI chat assistant for Novacane Studios, a recording studio in London. It sits on the studio's website as a chat widget, answers from Claude, finds free times and opens a booking card where the visitor pays the deposit to book. It also serves Portal, the staff app. Bookings are its own (Google Calendar, Gmail and Stripe).
projects.vision: A front desk that never closes: visitors get real answers and real bookings, and staff run enquiries, chats and bookings from their phones.
features: Themed chat widget with optional voice; Claude answers with every link checked
Free times, booking links and an in-chat booking card (deposit first)
Portal staff app: enquiries, customer chats, bookings by chat, push alerts
Enquiries, referral codes and a password-protected admin page
Its own booking page, Google Calendar diary, Gmail emails and Stripe deposits
352 Vitest tests, covering both booking systems and the switch
projects.run: npm run sandbox (wrangler dev --env sandbox) → http://localhost:8787

projects.name: Nova Club
projects.tagline: A members' app where every day is a moon
projects.goal: A members' app for the studio with membership tiers (Base Syndicate, Pro Engineer, Elite) and a booking calendar that follows the studio's real bookings live through Nova Bot's /club/busy feed (from the studio's Google Calendar).
projects.vision: Booking as astronomy: a full moon means the day is wide open, a new moon means it's fully booked, and each day is drawn as an orbit you drag a session along.
features: CosmicCalendar: a month where each day is a moon
DayOrbit: 10am to 11pm as an orbit with a draggable session
Live calendar sync with a full-screen celebration when a booking lands
Flash-sale deal carousel and notifications
Membership card, tier picker and a Mixes screen
Ambient music and sound effects generated by tools/make_sounds.py
projects.run: Open in Android Studio; debug APK at app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk

capture.note: Android only. Screenshots need an emulator.
